native_math_attempt.conclusion: Do not interpret separate drifting scene images or alpha-fixture enable receipts as native bloom acceptance. The ROI outputs are compared explicitly; no expected threshold split was established.

dynamic_chain_lifecycle.conclusion: Native SetEnableByName can reset dynamically added processes, immediately or after settling. Order must be checked and the custom chain reinstalled/reconnected before relying on private bindings.
